visual_action: The video displays a static image of Donald Trump and Mike Pence in the Oval Office, smiling and giving thumbs-up. The video then cuts to a second static, split-screen image showing Donald Trump on the left and Mike Pence on the right, both standing at podiums in front of American flags.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is shown in two still photographs, and the on-screen text poses a question about his and Pence's administration making it to a second term.

cast.name: Mike Pence
cast.evidence: He is shown in two still photographs alongside Donald Trump. The on-screen text's use of 'we' implicates him in the question about a second term.

on_screen_text.text: 2020: did we make it to a second term?

spoken_summary: There is no speech in the video; it consists only of music.
audio_music: A dramatic and emotional pop song plays throughout the clip, creating a mocking or ironic tone when paired with the on-screen text about Trump and Pence failing to win a second term.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single cut between two static images, resembling a simple slideshow.
cultural_references: The use of 'no❤️' is an internet meme format for delivering a dismissive or sarcastic negative answer.
central_claim: Donald Trump and Mike Pence did not win a second term in the 2020 presidential election.
intended_effect: To mock Donald Trump and Mike Pence for their 2020 election loss and amuse their political opponents.
